latest.title: Chatbots got safer but will still role-play self-harm with users - The Washington Post
latest.summary: A study of more than 50,000 conversations with AI found that they will help users role-play or write stories about suicide. ChatGPT and other artificial intelligence chatbots have become less likely t...
highlights: A study of more than 50,000 conversations with AI found that they will help users role-play or write stories about suicide. ChatGPT and other artificial intelligence chatbots have become less likely to encourage suicidal thoughts but will still engage in potentially harmful conversations and reinforce apparently delusional behavior, a new study found. AI companies including Google and ChatGPT-maker OpenAI have been sued by family members who allege the chatbots encouraged self-harm in heavy users who later died by suicide. A new study released Monday by Transluce, a nonprofit that aims to provide public oversight of AI, found that the latest AI models from Google, Claude chatbot provider Anthropic and OpenAI almost never explicitly encouraged or validated suicide. Chinese models were more likely to encourage delusional thinking, Transluce also found, and less likely to encourage users to seek support from other people. Transluce used AI to create simulated users who had more than 50,000 conversations with AI models from top U.S. and Chinese companies.

latest.title: Nvidia’s $3.5B MediaTek bet reveals its plan for tackling Big Tech’s AI chip buildout - TechCrunch
latest.summary: Nvidia is investing $3.5 billion into Taiwanese chipmaker MediaTek. As part of the deal, MediaTek will adopt Nvidia’s technology that will help it design custom chips for AI companies and hyperscalers...
highlights: Nvidia is investing $3.5 billion into Taiwanese chipmaker MediaTek. As part of the deal, MediaTek will adopt Nvidia’s technology that will help it design custom chips for AI companies and hyperscalers that can be plugged directly into Nvidia-based data centers. The deal comes as a growing number of AI companies and major cloud providers like Amazon, Google, Microsoft, OpenAI and Anthropic invest in building their own chips so they can be less reliant on Nvidia’s GPUs. Deals like this one with MediaTek allow Nvidia to cede ground to custom silicon while still maintaining its lead as the dominant data center scaffolding. “Nvidia is an AI infrastructure company,” Dion Harris, Nvidia’s senior director of HPC and AI hyperscaler infrastructure solutions, said on Monday on a call with reporters. With the Nvidia partnership, MediaTek can continue to build custom chips designed by cloud companies or AI labs tailored to their workloads, leveraging Nvidia’s “proven scale-up and scale-out technology stack and ecosystem” and “rack-scale architecture.”.

"Advertising is one pillar of OpenAI's diversified business model, alongside consumer subscriptions, enterprise offerings, and usage-based APIs," the company said in a statement. OpenAI's decision to introduce ads in its popular chatbot proved controversial, with rival Anthropic mocking the development in a Super Bowl ad. week.title: Chatbots got safer but will still role-play self-harm with users - The Washington Post
week.summary: A study of more than 50,000 conversations with AI found that they will help users role-play or write stories about suicide. ChatGPT and other artificial intelligence chatbots have become less likely t...
highlights: A study of more than 50,000 conversations with AI found that they will help users role-play or write stories about suicide. ChatGPT and other artificial intelligence chatbots have become less likely to encourage suicidal thoughts but will still engage in potentially harmful conversations and reinforce apparently delusional behavior, a new study found. AI companies including Google and ChatGPT-maker OpenAI have been sued by family members who allege the chatbots encouraged self-harm in heavy users who later died by suicide. A new study released Monday by Transluce, a nonprofit that aims to provide public oversight of AI, found that the latest AI models from Google, Claude chatbot provider Anthropic and OpenAI almost never explicitly encouraged or validated suicide. Chinese models were more likely to encourage delusional thinking, Transluce also found, and less likely to encourage users to seek support from other people. Transluce used AI to create simulated users who had more than 50,000 conversations with AI models from top U.S. and Chinese companies.

week.title: Nvidia’s $3.5B MediaTek bet reveals its plan for tackling Big Tech’s AI chip buildout - TechCrunch
week.summary: Nvidia is investing $3.5 billion into Taiwanese chipmaker MediaTek. As part of the deal, MediaTek will adopt Nvidia’s technology that will help it design custom chips for AI companies and hyperscalers...
highlights: Nvidia is investing $3.5 billion into Taiwanese chipmaker MediaTek. As part of the deal, MediaTek will adopt Nvidia’s technology that will help it design custom chips for AI companies and hyperscalers that can be plugged directly into Nvidia-based data centers. The deal comes as a growing number of AI companies and major cloud providers like Amazon, Google, Microsoft, OpenAI and Anthropic invest in building their own chips so they can be less reliant on Nvidia’s GPUs. Deals like this one with MediaTek allow Nvidia to cede ground to custom silicon while still maintaining its lead as the dominant data center scaffolding. “Nvidia is an AI infrastructure company,” Dion Harris, Nvidia’s senior director of HPC and AI hyperscaler infrastructure solutions, said on Monday on a call with reporters. With the Nvidia partnership, MediaTek can continue to build custom chips designed by cloud companies or AI labs tailored to their workloads, leveraging Nvidia’s “proven scale-up and scale-out technology stack and ecosystem” and “rack-scale architecture.”.
